summary: OpenAI describes new internal safeguards—monitoring, alignment, and security measures—that will guide the pace of frontier model development in light of emerging cyber-critical capabilities.

practices.reason: The post describes internal monitoring and security safeguards tied to cyber capability thresholds, but as an internal, lab-specific process it is not a transferable evaluation method.
practices.quote: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models.

notable_reason: A frontier lab explicitly tying the pace of model development to cyber-capability safeguards is a notable policy signal even though details are sparse in this summary.
